item.title: Designing AI Policy Engines & Constraint Systems in Production GenAI Platforms
item.description: Defining the AI Policy Engine An AI Policy Engine is a centralized governance layer that intercepts requests and responses to enforce organizational, safety, and operational constraints. In a production environment, an LLM is a non-deterministic engine; the policy layer acts as the deterministic supervisor.
